TransactionID.description: Unique identifier (UUID). Transaction ID, e.g., 4ba5a0b50d2c45b3b5eb343b57ba8897. Must be a 32-character random value. Used for internal log tracing.

AgencyID.description: Unique identifier for the travel agency (e.g., YOUR_TENANT_ID)

ContactInfoRefID.description:
Reference ID for travel agency contact information. For certain airlines (e.g., BA, AF, KL), providing specific contact details is mandatory for OrderCreateRQ and OrderChangeRQ messages. Failure to provide this information will result in an error. 
• OrderCreateRQ Requirements:
  - British Airways (BA): Agency email, postal address
  - Air France (AF), KLM (KL): Agency email, phone number
• OrderChangeRQ Requirements:
  - British Airways (BA): Agency email, postal address

items.description:
An individual reference ID for contact information. This ID links to detailed contact information that may be mandatory for specific airline NDC requests. For example, when creating or changing an order: 

•   OrderCreateRQ:
    -   British Airways (BA): Requires agency email and postal address.
    -   Air France (AF), KLM (KL): Requires agency email and phone number.
•   OrderChangeRQ:
    -   British Airways (BA): Requires agency email and postal address.

Failure to provide required contact details for these airlines will result in a processing error.

TravelAgencyType1.title: TravelAgencyType
TravelAgencyType1.description: Information pertaining to the Travel Agency in the context of NDC transactions.
